The '''Montezuma Pet''' is a [[Pet]] in the [[Rift]]. The player can upgrade it by finding Montezuma Soul Pieces around the Rift.

== Obtaining ==
A {{Rare}} '''Montezuma Pet''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Sad Jacquelle}} in the {{Zone|Wyld Woods}} after starting their quest and finding the first Montezuma Soul Piece. It is {{Lv|100}} by default.

== Montezuma Soul Pieces ==
There are {{Green|9}} Montezuma Soul Pieces that can be found in the Rift. After finding 6 pieces, the '''Montezuma Pet''' is upgraded to {{Epic}} [[rarity]]. Each piece found adds {{Stat|rt|+15}} to the Pet, and {{Stat|mana regen|+2}} when it is {{Epic}}.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' gives a base {{Stat|Rift Time|10}}, but the minimum amount the player can get from it is {{Stat|Rift Time|25}}, due to the {{AN|Nine Lives}} ability and needing at least one soul piece to obtain the pet.
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' cannot be transferred out of the Rift and does not contribute to the player's [[Pet Score]].
*If the player somehow manages to get a {{Item|Tier Boost}} into the Rift, it is possible to apply it to the '''Montezuma Pet''', and it will become {{Level|96}} {{Legendary}}. It does not gain any additional stats or perks.
**The SkyBlock Menu still shows the pet as {{Level|100}} {{Epic}}, and it will be reverted to such when the player leaves and rejoins the Rift.
*The '''Montezuma Pet''' appears to be a reference to the book ''[[w:The Nine Lives of Montezuma|The Nine Lives of Montezuma]]'', which is about a cat named Montezuma, hence the '''Montezuma Pet''' also being a cat.
